children: Cooper Standard entered into Amendment No. 6 to its asset-based revolving credit facility to enhance liquidity and extend maturities. The amendment increases total commitments by $20 million to $200 million, reduces interest rate margins, and removes credit spread adjustments for SOFR and CORRA. The facility now matures on September 3, 2031, with commitments allocable between U.S. and Canadian tranches based on availability.

: Bank of America, as agent, and other lenders
: Increase liquidity and reduce borrowing costs
